quarterly_data.quarter: Anji Microelectronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results: revenue RMB 1,526,359,564.44, up 33.72% YoY (CMP slurries +29.47%, functional wet electronic chemicals +51.03%); net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 531,763,849.95 (+41.56%); net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 425,764,261.57 (+19.35%), held back by an exchange loss of RMB 5,512.67 ten-thousand from US-dollar moves; pre-tax non-recurring fair-value and investment gains of RMB 12,467.57 ten-thousand. The company says R&D progress and market expansion met expectations and some products entered volume ramp in step with customers. Operating cash flow RMB 320,311,282.50 (+30.68%).

quarterly_data.quarter: Anji Microelectronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Product progress in H1 2026 (half-year report): ceria-based slurries for shallow-trench isolation and dielectric polishing are fully in volume production, with several slurries using the company's self-made ceria abrasive in volume use at several customers and supply still growing; a ceria post-CMP cleaning solution reached volume sales; several advanced-node silicon nitride slurries passed qualification and reached sales; customised tungsten slurries reached volume sales as first-choice supplier at several new customers; etchants passed validation and reached small-volume production; new-material slurries for more advanced nodes passed qualification and reached sales; copper and copper-barrier slurries kept ramping at advanced nodes.

quarterly_data.quarter: Anji Microelectronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Advanced packaging (half-year report): TSV electroplating solutions and additives entered volume production with sales, alongside IC damascene electroplating solutions in volume production; advanced-packaging tin-silver electroplating solutions remain in development and validation on plan; several products for 3DIC are the first choice at domestic customers, supporting domestic heterogeneous-integration technology. The company says that, with AI driving explosive demand for high-performance compute, its slurries now cover advanced-packaging uses such as hybrid-bonding and polymer slurries.

quarterly_data.quarter: Anji Microelectronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity (half-year report): the company says it raised utilisation of existing capacity and steadily expanded its production lines, completing the environment build-out of new production lines. Raised-fund projects: the 2023 private-placement projects are all closed (the Ningbo Anji CMP slurry construction project, the Jinqiao production-line automation project and the Jinqiao analytical-testing upgrade reached intended use on March 31, 2026; the Ningbo CMP slurry project reports 1,760.20 tonnes as its benefit realised this year); the convertible-bond projects had RMB 50,541.44 ten-thousand invested, 61.89% of the proceeds.
quarterly_data.figure: Ningbo CMP slurry project 1,760.20 tonnes realised this year; convertible-bond projects 61.89% invested
